control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.title: injury during cleaning and preparation on G-8102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on G-8102 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on G-8102 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on G-8102 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically testing for dead and applying earths. G-8102 (gas turbine generators) is in service for on-site generation. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 11 September 2021 an incident occurred on G-8102 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during cleaning and preparation, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
